The work is performed using a high-level combi truck. The operator sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is spacious enough for the worker to sit and move safely. The machine can reach heights of up to 12-16 meters, and the operator rises together with the cabin. Before ascending, the operator places an empty pallet on the forks. Occasionally, a full pallet is placed on the forks if it needs to be stored in the rack. When you are high in the air, you take boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The operator places the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the task, the machine descends. The operator then drives the truck to another location in the warehouse. As a Senior Demand Planner, you will be responsible for demand planning and forecasting within a specific Business Line of a leading high-tech manufacturing organisation in the Eindhoven region. You will take ownership of the demand forecast and play a key role in balancing customer demand, production capacity and inventory. Working in a dynamic high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environment, you will analyse demand patterns, identify risks and translate data and customer input into reliable forecasts and actionable insights. You will work closely with Production, Procurement, Sales, Project Management and Logistics and actively contribute to the monthly and quarterly S&OP process. You will have a high level of autonomy in managing the forecast, while working with stakeholders to align demand and supply and ensure the business is prepared for changes in customer demand. The role combines demand forecasting, data analysis, scenario planning and stakeholder management. You will also contribute to continuously improving planning processes and supply chain performance. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Full-time position, 38 hours per week Competitive gross monthly salary based on your experience and background Pension scheme and travel allowance Flexible working hours Personal development and career opportunities Access to sports facilities Meals and healthy snacks available at the workplace A professional and international working environment Wat levert deze baan jou op? This role gives you the opportunity to take real ownership of demand planning within a growing high-tech organisation. You will not simply maintain forecasts; you will be responsible for the quality of the forecast and have a direct influence on how the organisation responds to future demand. You will work in a complex high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environment, where customer demand can change quickly and where planning decisions have a direct impact on production, procurement and inventory. With a high levelof autonomy, you will work closely with multiple departments and customers and play an active role in the S&OP process.
